admin-fake-help: Fake disables AI embeddings, indexing, semantic search and Qdrant access. NodeBB and MCP tools remain available.
admin-keep-key: Leave empty to keep the current key
admin-embedding-help: The default dimension for text-embedding-3-small is 1536. Changing this value requires a matching Qdrant collection.
admin-excluded-help: Posts in selected categories are excluded from indexing and search.
admin-bind-help: 127.0.0.1 allows local connections only. 0.0.0.0 listens on all network interfaces.
admin-nodebb-api-help: Base URL used by the MCP process to access the internal NodeBB API. Use an address reachable from the MCP process environment.
admin-auth-help: OAuth is the default mode. Legacy Bearer is retained for existing installations and compatibility. In OAuth mode, static Bearer authentication is disabled.
admin-token-help: The token is only accepted in Legacy Bearer mode. Regenerating it immediately invalidates the previous token.
admin-service-uid-help: NodeBB service user ID used only in Legacy Bearer mode. OAuth uses the authenticated user's UID.
account-description: Applications authorized to access your forum account through MCP are listed below.
account-enabled: MCP access is enabled for your account.
account-enabled-description: Connected applications can access your account according to their individual permissions.
account-disabled: MCP access is disabled for your account.
account-disabled-description: No connected application can access your account. Enabling access again will require applications to authorize again.
consent-request-description: is requesting permission to access your forum through the Model Context Protocol (MCP).
consent-approval-explanation: If you approve, this client will be authorized to act with your forum account permissions. You can revoke this authorization later in your account settings.
error-invalid-transaction: The authorization request is invalid or has expired.
error-session-mismatch: This authorization request belongs to a different browser session.
error-client-unavailable: The client information is temporarily unavailable. Please try again.
error-client-changed: The client registration has changed. Restart authorization from your MCP client.
error-consent-load: The authorization page could not be loaded. Please try again.
error-login-required: Please sign in to your forum account and try again.
error-transaction-used: The authorization request has already been used or has expired.
error-access-disabled: MCP access is currently disabled for your forum account.
error-consent-process: The authorization decision could not be processed. Please try again.
admin-no-token: There is no Bearer token to copy
admin-confirm-regenerate: Regenerate the MCP Bearer token? The previous token will stop working immediately.
admin-token-missing: Server did not return the new token
